title: Moldova and Romania plan to develop Prut River navigation with links to Ukraine
summary: Moldova has proposed working with Romania to develop river infrastructure and restore navigation on the Prut River, partly to strengthen transport links with Ukraine.

title: Officer suspected of torturing subordinates extradited from Mondova to Ukraine
summary: A Ukrainian serviceman suspected of ill-treating his subordinates has been extradited from Moldova to Ukraine.

title: German city of Darmstadt donates generators to schools and kindergartens in Uzhhorod
summary: A delegation from the German city of Darmstadt, led by Mayor Hanno Benz, has donated five high-capacity generators worth more than €116,000 to Uzhhorod to ensure uninterrupted operations at schools and kindergartens.

title: SSU arrests suspected Russian agent posing as volunteer to direct strikes on Kramatorsk
summary: Counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has arrested a contract soldier who, according to investigators, had gone AWOL from his military unit and was helping Russian forces direct strikes on Kramatorsk in the Donetsk region.
